target_customer: Developers and companies building AI products that need serverless GPU compute, sandboxes and agents
problem: Developers building ML and AI apps struggle with infrastructure, slow cold starts and cloud lock-in.
business_model: Usage-based compute billing while code runs, plus open source self-hosting
product_category: Serverless AI cloud and developer tools

founders.name: Eli Mernit
founders.background_notes: Former competitive cyclist and hackathon winner per YC page.

founders.name: Luke Lombardi
founders.background_notes: Hardware and software engineer in robotics and ML. The founders were college roommates and built a serverless web framework before Beam.

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom container runtime, fast image loading and GPU scheduling are hard for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Open source code and many serverless GPU rivals make switching easy, though runtime performance gives some edge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Hyperscalers and Modal offered similar compute; no source shows an acquisition or copy of Beam.

market_need_then: ML developers in 2022 found prototyping and deployment hard; Slai's seed coverage framed it as a developer first ML platform.

branding.domain_note: Uses beam.cloud; the earlier Slai name is attributed to the same company by directories and funding databases.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, concise, with the call to action Give your agents their own machines

rebrands.why: Not stated; directories say the focus moved to serverless GPU infrastructure.

branding.community_and_virality: Open source with a beam-cloud GitHub organization; no community metrics found.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic real-word name shared with many companies, with no sourced press on the brand.

pivots.from: Slai, a developer-first ML prototyping platform
pivots.to: Beam, serverless GPU cloud for AI inference, sandboxes and agents
pivots.why: Not stated. Rebrand date and rationale are unconfirmed; the YC page does not confirm Slai as the earlier name.

outcome_analysis: Beam raised a 3.5M seed in May 2022 led by Tiger Global while it was Slai, then repositioned toward open source serverless GPU compute for agents. It remains active with named customers such as Coca-Cola and Magellan AI and a small team of five. No later round or exit is found, so funding may be incomplete.
notes: Seed confirmed by TechCrunch and Startup Intros/SeedTable. Total raised varies (3.63M to 4.75M) and is unverified. The Slai to Beam identity rests on directories and CB Insights, not the YC page. Directory pages dispute the second founder name (Regen vs Mernit); YC and TechCrunch say Mernit. Competitor search returned only undated current comparison pages (Modal, Replicate, Banana), so the list is empty. Outcome search found no acquisition, layoffs or later round.
